items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: Because Maynard, the entertainment director, had always said, 'As long as I'm here, you got a job.'

ctx.x: I began to dig the climate, and everything was kind of right for me. Plus that I had saved some money, I bought me some property, and I was...Hey, it was a new life for me. That's what it was really like, a new life. I'm playing every night, what I want to play, and dug the people I was playing with.

And -- snap! -- the job ended like that. The thing happened that they sold the hotel and brought in new owners, so the policies change. New entertainment director, new policy. You get your notice, you know. And I said, 'Wow, this thing is coming to an end too abrupt.' Because Maynard, the entertainment director, had always said, 'As long as I'm here, you got a job.'
But then he wasn't there any more.
